test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Dr. Brahm Prakash advised me to take care of the performance degraders and cautioned me against seeking __optimal __performance from the participating work centres.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Best**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• *SYNONYM* is a phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Optimal **means best or most approvable. 
 
• The word **Best** means of the excellent or most desirable kind or quality
 
• The meaning of word **optimal **is similar to the meaning of **best**,* hence best is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **minimum **means least or smallest 

*Example *: The **minimum **word limit is 1500 words.

 
• The word **faulty **means defective and wrong.

*Example *: This is a **faulty **bulb.

 
• The word **Worst **means poorest quality , bad.

*Example *: I had the **worst **experience of my life in this lounge.
